You can see a fridge. You can make out an opened oven nearby. The oven contains a diced raw red potato. I mean, just wow! Isn't TextWorld just the best? You can make out a table. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you make out a diced raw yellow potato and a cookbook. You can make out a stove. But the thing is empty.



There is a raw purple potato on the floor.
